stdout: Fault localization complete. `utils/hasher/hasher.go` exposes package `Reseed`/`HashFunc` and unexported `hasher`; it keeps `map[string]maphash.Seed`, generates opaque random seeds on `Reseed` and on first `HashFunc` call, and has no `SetSeed`. Thus a previous seed cannot be supplied or restored. Existing tests pass (`GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./utils/hasher`) but cover only repeat hashing and random reseeding. `db/db.go` registers HashFunc as SQLite SEEDEDRAND; album/mediafile repositories sort with it and reset it on first-page random requests. A fix should add exported `Hasher` and package/method `SetSeed`, store caller seed strings per ID, incorporate them into hashing with a global maphash seed, preserve lazy per-ID initialization and Reseed behavior, and cover seed restoration. Potential concurrent map access is a separate risk. No project source or tests modified.
